ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the diagram, after death, wolves and eagles are eaten by what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In this food web diagram there are multiple labeled boxes, including Eagle (Tertiary Consumer), Wolf (Secondary Consumer), and Fungus Decomposer. The red arrows in the diagram indicate the destination after death: below the Eagle box there is a red arrow pointing to Fungus Decomposer, and on the right side of the Wolf box there is also a red arrow pointing to Fungus Decomposer. Reasoning: The question asks what eats the wolf and eagle after they die. Because the red arrows after the deaths of the wolf and eagle both point to Fungus Decomposer, the answer is Fungus Decomposer.
